fee_details:
- For 1st Year: Rs. 0 on spending Rs.1,50,000 in 1st year
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs.1,000 (Annual fee waived off on spending Rs.2,00,000)
joining_perks: 1000 points as welcome bonus and renewal gift
reward_structure:
- For every Rs.150 spent on your card, you will get 3 reward points.
- These reward points can be redeemed for air miles at more than 20 international airlines and domestic airlines.
- The reward points which are added to your account will have a validity of 2 years from the date of accumulation.
key_highlights:
- A welcome offer of 1,000 reward points.
- On every spend of Rs. 150, get 3 reward points.
- Get 50% more reward points on every Plenty+ dining expense.
- Make the most of your dining experience by availing 50% more reward points on dining with your card.
- With a minimum of 4 transactions every month, get free Accidental Death Coverage and Burglary Protection.
- Get an annual benefit of 1,000 reward points.
- If you spend Rs. 1,50,000 within the first year, your annual fee will be waived off.
- Enjoy interest free period of up-to 50 days.

benefits_features.Welcome Benefits: Enjoy a welcome benefit of 1,000 reward points on paying the renewal fee for the next year, 1,000 reward points will be given to you.
benefits_features.Travel Benefits:
With the reward points accumulated in your credit card, you can convert them to purchase tickets at more than 20 international airlines through the Singapore Airlines Frequent Flyer Program.
You can also redeem reward points for Air Miles. These miles can be used for purchasing tickets from Jet Airways. The miles can also be redeemed against vouchers for other leading domestic airlines.
benefits_features.Dining Benefits: Enjoy 50% more reward points when you dine with your HDFC Bank Superia credit card.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits:
The fuel surcharge of 1% is waived off on all fuel transactions for minimum transactions of Rs.400.
The maximum cashback for fuel transactions is capped at Rs.500 per statement cycle.
benefits_features.Annual Fee Waiver: For Rs.1,50,000 spent in the first year the fee will be waived off, for next year fee will be waived off by spending Rs.2,00,000 in the year and your next year's annual fee will be waived off.

how_tos.How to Redeem reward points earned on HD:
The reward points on your Superia credit card can be redeemed through online or offline methods.
You can redeem the points offline through the fill by the reward redemption form which is available for download on the website. Once you have filled the form, it needs to be sent through the post to the following address:
HDFC Bank Card Division,
P.O. Box No. 8664,
Tharamani P.O.,
Chennai - 600044.
If you wish to redeem your reward points, you can do so by following the steps mentioned below:
- Log in to your HDFC credit card net banking account.
- Click on your credit cards tab.
- If your credit card is not registered, you will need to register it by inserting your card number and ALM/PIN.
- After your card is registered, click on the "Redeem reward points" and select "Continue".
- The website will then direct you to the rewards redemption page.
- Select "Redeem Reward Points".
- Select the category of the item you need.
- Once done, choose the points range to check the catalogue of various products.
- You can then select three items and add them in the cart for shopping cart.
- After you have chosen three products, click on "view cart".
- Once everything checks out, you are required to read the terms and conditions and check the box.
- Once done, click on redeem. The redemption order number which is given will be noted down for future references.

reward_point_benefits:
Get 3 reward points on every Rs.150 spent on your Superia credit card.
Make the most of your dining experience by availing 50% more reward points on dining with your card.
These reward points can be redeemed against AirMiles. These miles can be used to purchase flight tickets to top airlines in the country and abroad.
These reward points on your card have validity for 2 years from the date of accumulation.

miscellaneous: The card limit for the HDFC Bank Superia will be decided by the bank after considering several factors. The bank takes into consideration the primary applicant’s credit score and credit report. They will also look at the applicant’s credit and spending habits.

faqs.Which transactions shall be considered w: Transactions including debit/online/pos spends shall be considered. Please note, spends via add on card will be considered. Transactions related to cash at Call, IMPS, NEFT, Balance Transfer, Cash withdrawal at ATM and all transactions conducted from EMI or DMIs will not move into your Superia account.
faqs.What is the lifetime fee chargeable for: Rs.100 will be chargeable towards the issue of a lost or damaged Superia Credit card.
faqs.What kind of transactions done on the Su: All retail purchases qualify for Reward Points. Other transactions like cash advance fee and other charges does not earn any reward points. Only retail purchase qualify for reward points.
Cash advances, fees, and other charges also absolutely not qualify for reward points. Transaction amounts less than Rs. 150 will not accrue any Reward Points.
faqs.Does my Superia Credit Card also have a: Yes, the Superia credit card contains a magnetic strip and can be used for various transactions.
faqs.Are there any special conditions to avai: The Welcome & Renewal benefit is only permitted in the case of the cardholder is paying the annual fee.
